title: 第一卷第1章 大自在天魔经第一卷第2章 大衍剑经VS大自在天魔功
content_zh:
大齐朝。
西疆边陲，天武城，顾家。
正值入夜，大厅内灯火通明。
厅内中央，躺着一名身上满是鲜血，气息奄奄的少年，周围站着数十名顾家核心族人，个个杀气腾腾，好似群狼环伺！
“今有顾家养子，顾寒！”
“大逆不道，悖逆人伦，丧心病狂，残害同族，意图弑父！”
一名身材颀长的青年盯着少年，眼中带着残忍和快意，缓声道：“大族老有令，罢黜其少主之位，废其修为，断其经脉，逐出家族，放逐城外，以儆效尤！”
下方。
顾寒身不能动，一言不发，脸上满是血污，唯独一双眸子，死死盯着众人，眼中好似燃烧着熊熊烈焰，似要将眼前的一切焚烧殆尽！
“少爷！”
也在此时。
一道惊呼声突然自外间传来，却是一名抱着一柄破烂黑剑，十三四岁大小，明眸皓齿的少女。
“这个傻子？”
听到声音，青年讥讽一笑，忽地半蹲下身，看着顾寒道：“顾寒，我等这一天，等了十七年了，你觉得以你现在的状态，你和她能在城外妖兽的口中撑多久？一日？半日？亦或者……更短？”
顾寒眼中的火焰更盛，声音虽虚弱，却带着一丝刻骨铭心的恨意：“我，会回来！”
“好啊。”
青年起身，居高临下道：“我等着。”
“够了。”
厅内首位，大族老顾长一摆手，淡淡道：“扔出去。”
“是！”

当即便有人应声，拖着顾寒便往外走，人影晃动间，引得灯火摇曳，更衬得他脸庞忽明忽暗，阴郁中透着几分狠辣和自得。
“真像条狗。”
青年一吐胸中郁气，自得道：“一条丧家之犬！”
厅外。
夜色昏沉，少年被人随意拖着，伴随着少女的呼唤啜泣声，渐行渐远，彻底没入了一片漆黑中。
厅内。
热火朝天，顾长环顾众人，一指那青年，沉声道：“我孙儿顾阳，便是顾家新任少主，你们可有意见？”
“参见少主！”
众人神情热络，当即俯首拜服！
“诸位，免礼！”
顾阳哈哈大笑，心情大畅！
……
三日后。
天武城内。
朝阳初生，让这座边陲小城焕发出了几分生气来。
content_en:
Da Qi Dynasty.
On the western border, Tianwu City, Gu family.
It was night, and the hall was brightly lit.
In the center of the hall, there lay a young man covered in blood and dying, surrounded by dozens of core members of the Gu family, all filled with murderous intent, as if surrounded by a pack of wolves!
"Now we have the adopted son of the Gu family, Gu Han!"
"Rebellious, disobedient to human relations, insane, murdering fellow tribesmen, and intending to kill his father!"
A tall young man stared at the young man, with cruelty and pleasure in his eyes, and said slowly: "The big family has an old order to depose him from the position of young master, abolish his cultivation, cut off his meridians, expel him from the family, and banish him from the city, as a warning to others!"
below.
Gu Han couldn't move, didn't say a word, his face was covered with blood, and his only pair of eyes were staring at everyone, as if their eyes were burning with blazing flames, as if they were going to burn everything in front of them!
"Master!"
Also at this time.
An exclamation suddenly came from outside, but it was a girl of thirteen or fourteen years old, with bright eyes and white teeth, holding a tattered black sword.
"This fool?"
Hearing the voice, the young man smiled sarcastically, squatted down, looked at Gu Han and said, "Gu Han, I have been waiting for this day for seventeen years. How long do you think you and her can last in the mouth of the monster outside the city in your current state? One day? Half a day? Or... shorter?"
The fire in Gu Han's eyes grew stronger, and although his voice was weak, it contained a hint of unforgettable hatred: "I will be back!"
"Okay."
The young man stood up and said condescendingly: "I'm waiting."
"That's enough."
The first person in the hall, Gu Chang, an old man from a wealthy family, waved his hand and said calmly: "Throw it out."
"Yes!"
When someone answered, he dragged Gu Han out and walked out. As the figure swayed, the lights flickered, making his face flicker in and out, revealing a bit of ruthlessness and complacency in the gloom.
"Really like a dog."
The young man exhaled the depression in his chest and said proudly: "A lost dog!"
outside the hall.
In the gloomy night, the boy was dragged carelessly, accompanied by the girl's call and sobbing, gradually getting farther and farther away, and was completely submerged in darkness.
inside the hall.
In the heat of the moment, Chief Gu looked around at the crowd, pointed at the young man, and said in a deep voice: "My grandson Gu Yang is the new young master of the Gu family. Do you have any opinions?"
"See Young Master!"
Everyone looked enthusiastic and immediately bowed their heads in worship!
"Everyone, please excuse me!"
Gu Yang laughed loudly and was in a great mood!
…
Three days later.
Inside Tianwu City.
The rising sun gave this small border town a bit of life.
